app.name: Memory Swipe
app.tagline: Rediscover your memories. Make room for new ones.

onboarding.slide1Body: Swipe through your photos and videos and enjoy the moments you forgot you had.
onboarding.slide2Body: Swipe right to keep. Swipe left to set a photo aside for deletion.
onboarding.slide3Body: Nothing is ever deleted by a swipe. You review everything and confirm first.
onboarding.slide4Body: Your photos are never uploaded. All browsing and decisions happen on your iPhone.

permission.title: Allow access to your photos
permission.body: Memory Swipe needs access to your photo library to show your photos and videos. It only ever reads them to display them, and never uploads anything.
permission.deniedBody: To use Memory Swipe, turn on photo access in Settings.
permission.limitedBody: Memory Swipe can only see the photos you selected. Counts reflect just that selection.
permission.emptyBody: When you have photos and videos on this device, they'll show up here.

home.greeting: What would you like to revisit?
home.allReviewed: All caught up — nothing left to review here.

swipe.unavailableBody: This item couldn't be loaded. You can skip it.
swipe.iCloudBody: This item lives in iCloud. It may take a moment, or you can skip it.
swipe.emptyBody: You've reviewed everything in this collection.

review.title: Review for deletion
review.warningDeletesLibrary: These are removed from your Photos library, not just from this app.
review.warningICloud: If iCloud Photos is on, they're removed from your other devices too.
review.warningRecentlyDeleted: Photos keeps deleted items in Recently Deleted for about 30 days, where you can restore them.
review.confirmBody: iOS will ask you to confirm. This affects your Photos library.

result.title: All done
result.someRemain_one: {{count}} item is still waiting for deletion.
result.someRemain_other: {{count}} items are still waiting for deletion.

settings.title: Settings
settings.includeFavoritesHelp: Off by default, so your favorites are protected.
settings.resetProgressHelp: Clears your keep/delete decisions. Never deletes any photos.
settings.resetConfirmBody: This clears your review decisions only. Your photos are not touched.
